title: Monster Slider (Demo)
native_title: モンスター・スライダー
overview:
The tilt changes!? An unprecedented falling-block game is born!!

Dracula has kidnapped Claudia, and her sister Nina sets out with a Holy Cross to rescue her from a cast of monstrous minions.

Monster Slider is a competitive falling-block puzzle game. Pairs of colored blocks drop into a well with a slanted floor, and once placed they slide downhill. Line up three of the same color to clear them. Press L or R to tilt the floor the other way at any time, sending the blocks sliding to set up chain reactions. Chains bury your opponent's well under skull blocks, and clearing S blocks triggers your character's special ability. Fill your rival's well to win.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1-2 players
- Tilt the floor with the L and R buttons
- Characters with their own special abilities

傾きが変わる！？空前の落ちゲー誕生！！
